title: Tophat
description: Adds various utilities for datapacks, such as /gui, /motion, player data, and more
body:
# 📖 About
Adds various commands and other utilities. Datapackers and mapmakers may find this useful.

# 👀 Main Features

- **Player Data Access:** Gives ability to read and modify the player using the vanilla `/data` command
![Player data showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/eK23YiDJ/images/509ddc2cdb4e2146d534a5d3edeec9b418222a15.gif)

## Commands
- `/motion <add/set> <entity> <momentum>` - Applies the given momentum to the entity.
- `/gui <open/close> <player> <menu> <name> <force>`
  1. `close` - Closes a menu for the player. You can optionally specify the type of menu that should be closed.
  2. `open` - Opens a menu for the player. You can optionally specify the name of the container and whether it should open on top of other menus (`false` by default).
- `/eval <expression> <scale> <arguments/with>` - Evaluates mathematical and logical expressions represented as a string and returns its completion value. Supports variables via `arguments` and `with` macros.
- `/provoke <victim> <provoker>` - Provokes `victim` against `provoker`. If `victim` is a passive entity, it will panic instead.
- `/findblock <from> <to> <block> store <block/entity/storage>` - Searches for specific blocks within a defined cuboid. If the `store` argument is provided, it stores all found block IDs and their coordinates in the specified destination, returning the total count. Otherwise, returns 1 or 0 based on success.

**Full functionality is described on the [wiki](https://github.com/JustJabka/Tophat/wiki)** 💡
